study_identification.author_journal_year: Wu and Baeken, Biological Psychiatry: Global Open Science, 2024
study_identification.title: Sex Determines Anterior Cingulate Cortex Cortical Thickness in the Course of Depression

study_characteristics.study_objective: Assess whether sex differences influence anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) cortical thickness (CT) across the course of major depressive disorder (first-episode vs recurrent), leveraging linear mixed-effects models and normative modeling.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Linear mixed-effects models (AFNI 3dLMEr) for group and Group×Sex effects on ACC CT with covariates (age, sex, education; medication as covariate in sensitivity); FDR correction for multiple tests; normative z-scores analyzed analogously (Figures S3–S5). HAMD–CT associations tested via LME within FE and recurrent groups including covariates.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: Females show thinner ACC CT than males; sex modulates ACC CT across depression course: FE females thinner than FE males; FE males thicker than recurrent males and than healthy males; effects localized to emotional ACC (pgACC/sgACC); no lateralization differences.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Female FE MDD showed significantly thinner ACC CT than male FE MDD (pgACC and sgACC, not dACC; abstract notes Cohen's d≈0.65). Male FE MDD showed thicker ACC CT (sgACC/pgACC) than recurrent MDD males (d≈1.24) and thicker than healthy males (d≈0.85). Group×Sex interactions significant with FDR correction; findings replicated using normative z-scores (Figures S3–S5).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Cross-sectional design; all recruitment sites in China (generalizability); lack of sex-specific physiological/hormonal data; imbalance in group sizes (FE>>Recurrent); focus limited to ACC; subtype and treatment-resistance details unavailable.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Normative modeling used as individualized validation of LME findings; supports early sex-specific interventions targeting emotion-regulation circuitry (e.g., sgACC).

general_notes.general_notes: Journal inferred as Biological Psychiatry: Global Open Science (DOI path j.bpsgos). DOI metadata indicates 2023 acceptance; repository naming uses 2024 for study_id. Imaging pipeline: SPM12 segmentation, ANTs DiReCT thickness, DARTEL; HCP MMP atlas for ACC subdivisions. Site effects handled via LME and HBR random effects; no ComBat reported. Normative modeling used PCNToolkit v0.18; no EV/MSLL metrics reported.
